source_audit.method: Downloaded complete bilingual HTML snapshots. The drafting team read the corresponding Chinese papers; the lead edited the complete reader texts and checked their central claims and selected factual passages against the originals. A second, cross-assigned source comparison checked all eight reader essays and yielded the corrections recorded in the editorial receipt.
source_audit.external_thought_limits: This adaptation does not claim a fresh primary-source audit of every external thinker. It retains the SAE paper's distinctions between checked originals or excerpts, Khan's abstract, Hirschman via another paper, and secondary-only comparisons. The latter are not represented as established agreements, disagreements or refutations.
source_audit.scope: Principles and reader arguments, not an exhaustive technical translation, current-law guidance, a tax or distribution formula, or a complete corporate-governance design.

verification.publication_dates: Old publication dates and prior update blocks unchanged; case modification dates reflect added companion navigation. New theory essays use 3 November 2026.
